arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show edge image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: x
arg.description: Center x of the rectangle to track.

arg.name: y
arg.description: Center y of the rectangle to track.

arg.name: width
arg.description: Width of the rectangle to track, 0 for none: at startup the histogram is used instead, setting it to 0 at runtime stops tracking.

arg.name: height
arg.description: Height of the rectangle to track, 0 for none: at startup the histogram is used instead, setting it to 0 at runtime stops tracking.
